task: Implement log_event for the audit logger without using metrics emitter semantics.

candidate_memories.content: Audit logger log_event writes a structured JSON record to an append-only audit log with a UUID.
Audit log entries must be immutable; they cannot be updated or deleted after writing.
Audit events must include actor, action, resource, and timestamp for compliance requirements.
When log_event spans audit and metrics systems, verify the immutability requirement before coding.
Metrics emitter: log_event increments a named counter with labels and optionally samples a histogram.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: mutable metric counter semantics conflict with immutable audit log requirements

candidate_memories.content: Old observability note says log_event should emit to both audit and metrics systems simultaneously.
